meta.ci: 95% t-interval over seeds (half-width), std is ddof=1
meta.persistence: trailing mean of k windows within a recording (measurement_id, by window_index); windows without k-1 predecessors in the recording are dropped; tau_k = p99.5 of equally smoothed val scores; delay = (k-1)*1024/64000 s

row_mapping.val_healthy: array row = window_index = manifest file order
row_mapping.test_healthy: array row = window_index = manifest file order
row_mapping.test_fault: array row = window_index = manifest file order

significance.test: Welch two-sample t-test (scipy.stats.ttest_ind, equal_var=False) over per-seed values; Holm-Bonferroni within each metric family
